# Direct method seed with a fixed nominal result

An owned public instance method accepts its own Object-bounded method formal and
returns a fixed nongeneric class with a closed generic superclass and marker.
A static generic wrapper obtains the original receiver before virtual dispatch.
Four frozen caller routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK providers,
including an owned future override, null receiver/input/result, opaque and aliased
results, partial writes, exact checked/runtime/error failures and later casts.
Every generated source and original metadata entry, including the methodless
marker, is compiled and audited. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving
Signature controls guard the proof. Only owned classes execute.
